title: Delegation: from sign-in to a dispatched tool call
lede: The customer signs in (mock), consents, and the BFF exchanges the user token and the agent token for a delegated token whose act claim names the agent. The gateway checks it, Authorize decides, and only then does the tool run. Simulated: every token is a labelled MOCK.

edges.label: token exchange (RFC 8693): user token + agent token
tool call with the delegated token

steps.title: Mock sign-in
steps.what: {{castUser}} or {{castUser2}} signs in as a persona. The token is a labelled MOCK, signed with a public mock key.

steps.title: Consent
steps.what: The customer lets {{castAgent}} act for them (may_act) before any exchange.

steps.title: Token exchange
steps.what: The user token and the agent token become a delegated token: sub is the customer, act names the agent. Delegation, not impersonation.

steps.title: Gateway check
steps.what: Signature, audience, expiry, act, scope and edge policy are checked before anything else.

steps.title: Authorize decision
steps.what: PERMIT, DENY, or an obligation (step-up, human approval, CIBA). The thresholds are the lab's own.

steps.title: Tool dispatched
steps.what: Only a permitted call reaches the tool. A denial or an obligation stops here and nothing is dispatched.
